CER: Levenshtein distance between decoded mapped29class sequence and observed target / positive target length, per sentence. Under this fixed-length ABI CER is in[0,1]; do not silently apply that bound to a future variable-length endpoint.
aggregation: first pool all selected sentence CERs of each modality-local person across BOTH folds, each sentence equal; then equal mean over19MEG or20EEG persons. Do NOT average folds equally or micro-average keys; no pooled39person statistic.
count_status: one existing canonical066 benchmark; arms/cases/modes/contrasts/fits are not additional benchmark IDs

definedness.complete_person: both complete fold supports with all expected sentences/keys and producer lineage
definedness.contrast: both streams complete for every planned person and own required reference/cost/semantic qualification; otherwise null, never available-case averaging
definedness.empty_or_nonfinite: typed undefined/incomplete; never zero, NaN JSON or accepted perfectscore
definedness.fullprogramme: any required input/fit/prediction/closure missing => incomplete; separately retained valid diagnostics cannot promote fullprogramme
definedness.modality_metric: all planned people required, otherwise null with exact missing/failed IDs retained
definedness.qualification_vs_numeric: finite metric may be mechanically computable yet comparison scientific qualification false; do not conflate artifact validity with biological evidence
definedness.source_unavailable: known missing/unqualified geometry,asset/environment role; retain exact census

difference: within modality and same person, comparator personCER minus NEURAL/person score for advantage, or frozen minus adaptive for mode benefit, or reference minus candidate for candidate benefit; average paired people. Null/negative valid.
family: all164 planned contrasts in CONTRAST_ROSTER.json, descriptive and signed; no positive-finding cherry-pick or corrected inferential significance claimed
greedy: argmax perrow; lowest classindex tie; output length exactly known target keycount
independent_pass: second implementation derives edit distances, decoded sequences, sentence/person aggregation and all contrast values independently from exact admitted probabilities and target support; shared immutable metadata allowed, shared numerical scalar outputs/metric callable not allowed; exact integer distances/identities plus predeclared floating tolerance1e-12. Any mismatch blocks report.
probabilities: every expected sentence has exactly n_keys rows x29 finite probabilities in[0,1], row sum within1e-6, exact support/order/case/arm/generation/mode-receipt join; no missing/duplicate/extra outputs
reasoning: investigation estimand+limitations and public entropy/row assertions are admitted before protected scoring. Entropy is not accuracy or neuroscience understanding. Method/source review checks reasoning/provenance; no new numerical prose-quality score is selected.
uncertainty: sample SD of complete person values /sqrt(N) and paired person differences SE are DESCRIPTIVE ONLY under shared training and templates. No independent39-person estimate, calibrated CI/p-value/bootstrap or semantic independence claim.
